about: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited manufactures, distributes, and retails fashion apparel and accessories in India and internationally. It operates through Pantaloons and Ethnic & Others segments. The company offers shirts, trousers, denims, t-shirts, dresses, suits and blazers, casuals, ceremonial, and party wear; shorts, joggers, track pants, sweatshirts, jackets, polos, chinos, kurtas and bottom wear, occasion wear, festive ensembles, classic shirts, logo T-shirts, casual pants, lehengas
